narrative.overview: Plain work, done carefully, with one satisfying gesture. India Post supplies the colour and the one move. Everything around the stamp stays quiet.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface family, self-hosted, with a metric-matched fallback.
Committed colour in the shell, a neutral ground below.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: The stamp is the only decorative motion in the product. If another effect wants to exist, it loses.

rules.name: The Reason Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries meaning alone. Every state also has a word.

rules.name: The Single Job Rule
rules.body: Each accent colour has one job. Yellow flags, green keeps, red cancels, violet stamps.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No all caps anywhere. Weight and size carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every rupee amount is set in tabular lining figures.

dos: Do show the reason beside every result.
Do keep the savings readout in view while the person marks items.
Do use the stamp only when an item is marked Cancel.
donts: Don't use brand logos, stock art, gradient blobs, glass or emoji.
Don't turn the screen into a post office costume.
Don't colour a state without also naming it in words.
